focused_tests.skip_reason: CUDA runtime unavailable on packaging host
coverage_scope: density planning and sparse mesh compatibility

root_cause.finding: The direct LD8-S3 sparse tile executor did not consume the live PAR-DENS cooperative worker lease; admitted direct fields therefore used approximately one CPU core each while the scheduler waited correctly for completion.
root_cause.gpu_semantics: Direct sparse tiles are CPU execution. GPU execution is optional and only applies to approved FFT tiles.

four_density_preset_realization.note: The smoke was intentionally stopped during the subsequent sparse-mesh rendering hotspot after density realization had completed.

full_10001_frame_four_density_note.qualification_host_limit: The 4 GiB packaging cgroup rejects the full four-field Phase-B plan on memory authority, so no full four-density wall-time factor is claimed here.
full_10001_frame_four_density_note.applicability: The corrected direct kernel uses the same approved pair-chunk contract independent of frame count; full-trajectory one-field stack capture reproduced the former one-core direct executor before this fix.

remaining_downstream_hotspot.note: Separate renderer optimization gate; not part of density scientific realization HARDEN4.
